Trace, implement and test: Generate ISBN

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
package com.cts.utility;

// System Under Test
public class GenerateISBN {
	private Book book; // Dependency that has to be mocked

	public GenerateISBN(Book book) {
		super();
		this.book = book;
	}
	
	// Method to be tested
	public Book assignISBN(String isbn) {
		if(isbn.matches("ISBN[0-9]{4}")) {
			book.setIsbn(isbn);
		}else {
			throw new RuntimeException("Invalid Code");
		}
		return book;
	}
}
